claim: The first calendar quarter of 2025 net income result was around $2.1B at Adobe.
summary: From memory alone Adobe reports fiscal not calendar quarters, with early-2025 GAAP ~$1.8B and non-GAAP ~$2.2B for fiscal Q1 ended Feb 2025; the precise calendar-Q1 GAAP net income around $2.1B cannot be established without citations.

sub_claims.text: Adobe had a net income result for the first calendar quarter of 2025
sub_claims.stated_text: first calendar quarter of 2025 net income result ... at Adobe
sub_claims.note: From memory Adobe reports fiscal quarters ending Feb/May/Aug/Nov, not calendar quarters, so a direct calendar-Q1 net income result is not established without sources.

Recalled early-2025 is fiscal Q1 ended Feb 2025 with GAAP net income ~$1.81B and non-GAAP ~$2.22B; around $2.1B is closer to non-GAAP than GAAP and calendar-Q1 GAAP is not established from memory alone.
